description: Configuration for XGIC Payload CMS project creation via `xgic payload setup`. Application templates use layout app-root (projectDir '.') so Payload/Next live at the repo root.

projectName.description: Payload/npm project identity (Compose-safe characters). With layout app-root this is not a subdirectory.
projectName.title: Projectname

projectDir.description: Relative directory for the generated app. Use '.' for this template (app-root).
projectDir.title: Projectdir

layout.description: app-root for pure application repos (this template). subdir/auto used by the image producer.
layout.title: Layout

composeProjectName.description: Docker Compose project name. Must match top-level compose name:, XGIC_COMPOSE_PROJECT, and related container/volume/network names. Consumers who fork or rename should update all of these together.
composeProjectName.title: Composeprojectname

template.description: Which official Payload starter template to scaffold

example.description: Optional: Use a specific Payload example instead of a template
example.title: Example

agent.description: Coding agent skill to install inside the generated project. Use 'none' (recommended) when running inside a Dev Container or CI.

dbAdapter.description: Database adapter to configure for the generated project

dbName.description: Logical database name (used when creating the DB in Postgres/Mongo)
dbName.title: Dbname

dbUri.description: Optional database connection string. In normal Dev Container usage live credentials come from `.devcontainer/.env` (generated by `xgic payload env --regenerate --yes`). Leave empty unless you intentionally override.
dbUri.title: Dburi

adminEmail.description: Email address for the initial admin user in the Payload admin panel
adminEmail.title: Adminemail

telemetry.description: Whether to enable Payload's anonymous telemetry
telemetry.title: Telemetry

title: XGIC Create Payload Config
